title: The Way of the Leaf
_style: Applied to EVERY still. Image prompts are a technical brief, layered not short: SHOT + LENS + LIGHT + TEXTURE + COMPOSITION + STYLE. Naming real camera bodies and lenses is the single cheapest realism lever.
style: cinematic still, 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cool morning light, volumetric mist, fine organic texture, muted green and slate palette, photographic not illustrative
_negative: Negative constraints are a lever, not an afterthought.
negative: blur, distortion, low quality, text, watermark, warped hands, oversaturated
_models: Optional per-provider overrides. Omit to take the provider defaults.
_scenes: N scenes produce N-1 clips and serve as N poster stills. `image` describes a STATIC frame. `title`/`body` are the copy the runtime shows for that scene.

scenes.title: Before it becomes tea.
scenes.body: High in the mountains, mist settles slowly on the youngest leaves.
scenes.image: wide establishing shot of terraced tea fields on a steep mountainside at dawn, layered ridgelines receding into mist, a stone path threading between rows, foreground tea leaves catching the light

scenes.title: Gathered only at dawn.
scenes.body: Hands choose the tender tips — two leaves and a bud.
scenes.image: medium shot of a picker in a woven conical hat moving between waist-high tea rows, wicker basket at the hip, wet leaves in the near foreground, valley soft behind

scenes.title: Time becomes fragrance.
scenes.body: Across woven bamboo trays, each leaf softens and reveals its character.
scenes.image: interior of a timber drying house, long bamboo trays of withering leaves receding toward a bright doorway, dust suspended in a shaft of light, warm wood against cool exterior

scenes.title: Fire remembers the hands.
scenes.body: Copper, charcoal and the steady movement of the maker.
scenes.image: close shot of hands turning leaves in a wide copper pan over charcoal, ember glow underlighting the steam, dark surrounding room, shallow focus on the leaves

scenes.title: A quiet road to water.
scenes.body: Tea leaves the workshop by the same path that carries rain and cedar.
scenes.image: narrow stone mountain road under tall cedars, wet surface reflecting an overcast sky, mist between the trunks, the path curving out of frame

scenes.title: The whole valley, in one cup.
scenes.body: The mountains return in the steam above dark water.
scenes.image: overhead close shot of a dark ceramic cup of tea on weathered wood, steam curling in raking side light, single leaf resting beside the cup

_motions: One per GAP, so exactly scenes.length - 1. WHAT moves + HOW it moves + HOW the camera behaves, ~20-40 words. Do NOT re-describe the image — the model already has it. One shot = one camera move. Motion needs an endpoint; here the end frame supplies it.
motions: camera pushes forward down the terrace path at a steady walking pace, foreground leaves sweeping past the lens left and right, mist drifting slowly right to left
camera descends and settles toward the picker as the leaves part, hands continuing their steady picking rhythm, gentle parallax between the near rows and the far valley
camera glides through the doorway into the drying house, dust turning in the light shaft, trays sliding past on both sides, motion easing as the interior opens
camera tilts down toward the copper pan, steam rising continuously, ember light pulsing, hands keeping their turning rhythm without pause
camera lifts from the road and drifts forward between the cedars, mist thinning ahead, wet stone sliding underneath, easing to rest as the cup comes into frame
